records.title: Investing.com XRP quote and 30 October historical row — source classification correction
records.note: Direct page inspection shows the header '# XRP' and provider 'Investing.com'; it does not identify OKX or another venue. This corrects the prior archive record SRC-INVESTING-OKX-XRP-20261030T034135Z, whose title/venue label was over-specific although its URL points to the generic XRP page. At 06:33:27 UTC the page displayed 1.2610 USD, -2.92% over 24h. The 30-Oct row separately showed last 1.2599, open 1.2348, high 1.2612, low 1.2029, displayed volume 533.71M and daily change +2.03%. The volume denomination and aggregation methodology are not exposed. At 07:09 UTC the quote was approximately 36 minutes old; it is not a live consolidated multi-venue quote.
